dedupe_keys.name: brezplacne wifi tocke v obcini sevnica

description: Brezplačne WiFi točke v občini Sevnica is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA SEVNICA. The database contains information on the locations of free WiFi points in the municipality of Sevnica. The following data are included: Wifi point location, location description, WiFi network type, coordinates and device type. The collection is kept for the purpose of providing transparent access to the locations of free WiFi points via the map. Coverage: OBČINA SEVNICA. The portal shows the English title as "Free WiFi points in the municipality of Sevnica" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA SEVNICA. Its keywords include WiFi točke, občina Sevnica, Wi-Fi, Sevnica, WiFi. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX, HTML, CSV, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
